== Education ==

Sen received a National Merit Scholarship from the Government of India during his education (1962–66). Sen completed his [[Bachelor of Science]] at [[Gujarat University]] in Physics in 1963. He later completed both a [[Master of Science]] and [[Doctor of Philosophy]] in Physics at the [[University of Tennessee]] in 1971. Following his doctoral studies, Sen became a [[Postdoctoral researcher]] at [[Oak Ridge National Laboratory]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Education |url=https://www.ipr.res.in/theory/Prof_Abhijit_Sen/Academic.htm}}</ref>

== Award and honours ==
Sen's awards include:<ref>{{Cite web |title=Award |url=https://www.ipr.res.in/theory/Prof_Abhijit_Sen/honour.htm}}</ref>

* Young Scientist award from [[Indian National Science Academy]]
* Fellow, Gujarat Science Society
* Fellow of [[Indian Academy of Sciences]]<ref>{{Cite web |title=Indian Academy of Sciences |url=https://fellows.ias.ac.in/profile/v/FL1995019 |access-date=2022-09-17 |website=fellows.ias.ac.in}}</ref>
* Fellow of [[National Academy of Sciences, India]]
* Fellow of [[Indian National Science Academy]]<ref>{{Cite web |title=INSA :: Indian Fellow Detail |url=https://www.insaindia.res.in/detail.php?id=P06-1422 |access-date=2022-09-17 |website=www.insaindia.res.in}}</ref>
* Fellow of [[American Physical Society]]
* Fellow of [[Institute of Physics]]
* Senior Associate of [[International Centre for Theoretical Physics]]

== Science leadership ==
Sen is member of many organisations <ref>{{Cite web |title=Member |url=https://www.ipr.res.in/theory/Prof_Abhijit_Sen/carrier.htm}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Space Applications Centre |url=https://www.sac.gov.in/Vyom/scienceDay_sac.jsp |access-date=2022-09-17 |website=www.sac.gov.in |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220724194001/https://www.sac.gov.in/Vyom/scienceDay_sac.jsp |archive-date=2022-07-24 |url-status=dead}}</ref>

* Chairman of [[International Union of Pure and Applied Physics]]
* Chairman of board of governors [[Indian Institute of Geomagnetism]]<ref>{{Cite web |title=Prof. Abhijit Sen {{!}} Indian Institute of Geomagnetism (IIG) |url=https://iigm.res.in/content/prof-abhijit-sen-0 |access-date=2022-09-17 |website=iigm.res.in}}</ref>
* Member Editorial board of [[Plasma Sources Science and Technology]], [[Plasma Physics and Controlled Fusion]], [[Nuclear Fusion (journal)]], [[Pramana (journal)]], [[Indian Journal of Physics]]
* Member Academic Council [[Visva-Bharati University]] [[Indian Institute of Geomagnetism]]
* Member Science and technology advisory committee [[ITER]]
